summary:
Frontend-only Playwright E2E testing (1920x1080 and 1366x768) of the new drink-making minigame, bulk orders on Day 4+, the tutorial drink step, and regression. Also ran a node simulation of order generation (2000 drafts per day/mode). Almost everything works and no console or page errors were seen in any run. One real bug was found: when the pour button is released with the mouse/pointer on drinks that have a Tarik/Kacau step, a stir hit is registered immediately with the needle at 0, which lowers quality. A few minor UX issues remain.

What passed:
- Minigame panel: drink-game appears after Sediakan and shows 'cawan n/total'. Step chips are correct for every case: sejuk gives Masukkan ais/Tuang/(Tarik|Tutup), panas gives Panaskan/Tuang/..., bilik gives Tuang/Tutup cawan. Teh Tarik needs 3 hits, Bandung 2, Susu Segar 1, and Kopi O/Teh Lemon/Kola/Air Mineral get the lid step.
- Ice: the count increments. The wrong count shows the warning 'Ais sepatutnya 3 ketul untuk cawan sederhana' and gives quality 80 (one step at 70).
- Heat: released at 34 it warns 'Belum cukup panas' and stays on the heat step. Released at 74-76 it moves to pour. Holding for 5s gives 'Terlalu panas!'.
- Pour: released at 88-92% it is perfect. Over 115% it spills: fill resets to 0, toast 'Tertumpah! Cawan baharu digunakan…', an extra cup cost is deducted (funds checked: 323.70-0.40-0.40-0.40=322.50), and quality has -10.
- Stir: the needle moves, and hits in the green zone give 100.
- Lid: completes the cup, which goes to drink-tray with its quality.
- Quantity 2 starts the next cup automatically (cawan 2/2). Batal cancels and returns to the config.
- Space key: adds ice; hold works for heat and pour; press works for stir and lid. No double trigger when a button is focused.
- Confirm and Clear during a cup show the toast 'Siapkan atau batalkan minuman yang sedang dibuat dahulu.' and the cup is kept.
- Confirm validation: a partial tray gives 'belum lengkap — 0/1', wrong cups give 'Perlu Dibetulkan' with messages, and a full tray gives Siap and drinks-complete.
- Pause: while paused (Esc), fill (36→36), heat (45→45) and the stir needle (52→52) are frozen, and they resume afterwards.
- Tutorial: the Kola S sejuk step goes ice x2 → pour → lid → confirm. The tutorial moves from step 7 to 8 to 9, delivers with 5 stars, and shows 'Mula Syif Sebenar'.
- Bulk orders: ticket-bulk badges 'Pesanan Besar · 7 item' appear on Day 4 and 5. Node simulation: badge on 27% (Day 4) and 34% (Day 5) of orders, and bulk-like (≥2 burgers and ≥2 drinks) on 37-45%. Max 10 units and max RM51.40, so never over 10 items or RM80. Bill always equals sum(unit*qty) - discount, tender is always ≥ total, and change is always makeable from the drawer. 0 invalid drink temperatures in 16,000 drafts.
- In the browser, 15+ bills were paid with the receipt-computed total and greedy change, all 'Baki tepat'.
- Full bulk order #103 (seed 22, Day 5) was delivered with 5 stars and food accuracy 100: 3 beef patties via 'Letak Semua (3)', 2 burgers with exclusions, fries, and 3 different drink configs via the minigame (panas Teh Lemon, Bandung L with stir, Susu Segar L with stir).
- Regression: the Day 4 shift at 10x speed reached the summary screen and the ledger math is consistent (154.40+1.40-154.40=1.40; 300+1.40-25=276.40). The earlier Esc-on-Buku-Menu bug is fixed: Esc closes the dialog and no pause menu appears.

ui_bugs.issue: Releasing the 'Tekan & Tahan: Tuang' button with the mouse/pointer on a drink that has a stir step immediately registers one Tarik/Kacau hit with the needle at 0 (score about 28). Reproduced every time: right after the mouse release the text reads 'Tarik 1/3' or 'Kacau 1/2'. Bandung quality was 88 with mouse pour against 99 with Space pour; Teh Tarik was 92. Root cause: the pour and stir branches render the same DOM shape (p, Band, button), so React reuses the same <button>. The browser's click event fires after pointerup on that reused node, which now has onClick=DRINK_GAME_STIR. Fix: give StepControls (or each step's button) a key, e.g. <StepControls key={`${dp.left}-${dp.step}`} dp={dp} />.

'working' is based on flavour only (s.drinkTray.cups.some(c => c.flavour === l.flavour)). In bulk orders with the same flavour in different sizes or temperatures, a finished Kopi O M panas cup made the Kopi O L sejuk line show 'Sedang Disediakan'. The cup currently in the minigame (drinkPrep) is not considered, so the line being made shows 'Belum Disediakan'. Match flavour, size and temp, and include s.drinkPrep.
Two identical wrong cups produce the same message twice ('Salah jenis Bandung (sepatutnya Teh Lemon), saiz Kecil … ' x2). Deduplicate the message or add a count.
Heat is not capped: holding for 5s shows '135°C'. Clamp it at 100 (and maybe auto-stop or burn at 100).

issues: The game ticks at 100ms (setInterval) and the needle moves at 1.3/s, so it jumps about 13% per frame across a 20%-wide green zone. The needle is visible in the zone for only 1-2 frames per pass, which looks jumpy. At ?speed≥2 it can skip the zone entirely. Consider interpolating with rAF, a CSS transition, or a slower needle.

While the first cup is in progress, the tray exists with 0 cups, so drink-tray shows an empty dashed box without the 'Dulang kosong' text. Sahkan and Kosongkan look enabled even though they only warn.
The HUD wraps: Buku Menu and Jeda move to a second row, and fx toasts overlap the Jeda button. The station panel scrolls internally, so the 'Minuman' title is clipped while the minigame is shown.

The badge is shown only when units ≥ 7, but generateBulkLines can produce 5-6 unit orders (about 10% of orders are bulk-generated with no badge). This is acceptable but inconsistent; consider flagging the order from generateLines instead.

action_items: Fix the ghost stir hit after mouse pour release: add key={`${dp.left}-${dp.step}`} to StepControls (or a key on each step's button) so React remounts the button between steps
Drink line status: match flavour+size+temp for 'Sedang Disediakan' and include s.drinkPrep
Deduplicate identical wrong-cup messages in confirmDrinks
Optional: smoother stir needle (rAF/interpolation); show 'Dulang kosong' when the tray has 0 cups; HUD wrap at 1366px
critical_code_review_comments: DrinkGame.jsx hold(): onPointerUp dispatches STOP, but there is no onPointerLeave/lostpointercapture handling if setPointerCapture is unsupported. This is mostly fine with capture.
engine.js DRINK_GAME_CANCEL: the cost of the cancelled cup is already spent (newCup charges up front). This is intended as waste, but the cancel toast does not tell the player.

engine.js tick(): heat and pour are integrated at 100ms granularity. Pour per tick is 0.036-0.042 against a 0.15 window, which is fine. Stir per tick is 0.13 against a 0.2 window, which is borderline.
orders.js: the bulk flag (units>=7) is computed separately from the bulk generator path.
updated_files: /app/tests/rb_pay_helper.py (new helper: pay() snippet for receipt-total + greedy change)

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all requested flows work; 1 medium bug in mouse pour→stir, 3 low issues)

seed_data_creation: None. A localStorage save rushbite_save_v1 was injected for day 4 and day 5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Day 5 ?speed=1&seed=11: #101 is bulk (7 items) with Kopi O M panas, Teh Lemon M sejuk and Kopi O L sejuk; it is the first customer and appears after about 2s. Day 5 seed=22: #102 and #103 are bulk; #103 (3rd order) has 3 beef patties and Teh Lemon S panas, Bandung L sejuk and Susu Segar L sejuk. Precise stir clicks: evaluate a rAF loop reading drink-game-stir-bar children[1].style.left 'calc(X% - 4px)' and click the stir button when X is in 44-56. Use keyboard Space down/up for pour to avoid the ghost-hit bug when verifying quality=100. Grill/fryer polling: grill-status-i labels 'Terbalikkan sekarang!' and 'Sedia'; fryer-status-i 'Sedia'. Assembly: map asm-checklist li names to asm-add-* buttons by span text.
rca of the issue: Ghost stir hit: DrinkGame StepControls returns structurally identical trees for 'pour' and 'stir' (div > p + Band + button). On pointerup the pour button dispatches DRINK_GAME_POUR_STOP, the reducer advances the step to 'stir', and React reconciles the same <button> DOM node with new props (onClick=DRINK_GAME_STIR). The browser then fires 'click' on that node because pointerdown and pointerup hit the same element, so a stir hit is recorded at needle=0 (score 100-0.4*180=28). Reproduce: order with Teh Tarik or Bandung → prepare → hold the pour button with the mouse → release at 90% → the text shows 'Tarik 1/3'. Mitigation: key the StepControls by step and cup, or call e.preventDefault() in onPointerUp and ignore clicks within about 50ms of a step change.
